profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Platform Engineer | Color-Science Enthusiast
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with experience building web APIs, productivity software, automated documentation generation, and database driven training frameworks. Experienced with NodeJS, AWSs services and devops methodology. 

Over the past decade I've developed solutions for clients like Nike, Babcock International Group, the United Kingdom's Royal Navy, Yum!, and the Seminole Tribe of Florida.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked with platform engineers to design and develop robust AWS asset management services.
• Designed system level architecture to be used by team when standing up new search services. 
• Lead team of engineers during implementation of a new platform team.
• Implemented CI/CD pipelines for aforementioned services using Jenkins. 
• Design Elastic Search index mappings to provide clear and concise data objects to front end teams.
• Collaborated with front end engineers to create and maintain comprehensive API contracts. 
• Worked alongside product owners and scrum master to create stories that allow platform engineers to build aforementioned services.
• Develop NodeJS CLI applications for managing ElasticSearch index mapping. 
• Documented and unit tested services.
• Develop REST APIs for managing DynamoDB and ElasticSearch data.
• Develop robust integration and contract testing solutions for NodeJS services.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: • Identify best practices and workflows used in the virtual reality game and software industry and document those for a future training community.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed a full stack time lapse delivery application with Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB on the back end and Handlebar.js on the front end.
•	Developed Node.js scripting the Raspberry Pi 3 to take and deliver images.
•	Application and database run on an Amazon EC2 Ubuntu instance.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: •	Developed a Node.js and Amazon AWS SDK S3 bucket downloader to quickly download an S3 bucket, bypassing the web interface.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed and documented a robust, VBA based Course Structure Manager, a bespoke competency framework-based requirements analysis, management and documentation toolset developed specifically for the Project Faraday, a Babcock Flagship initiative for the UK’s Royal Navy.
• Developed database backend for a bespoke requirements analysis and course management database with a frontend user interface and DSAT-compliant export capability. 
• Trained team members on the continued use and administration of the CSM toolset. 
• Developed JavaScript dashboards to analyze trainee Moodle data in real time.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: •	Developed a full stack Amazon Dash button, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and Angular.js application to track daily cat feedings.

positions.title: Solutions Developer
positions.description:
• Assist acting Solutions Architect in the design and development of business solutions. Assisted in customer training and technical documentation
• Designed and Developed SharePoint site workflows and connected Microsoft InfoPath forms for the Seminole Tribe of Florida.
• Designed and Developed Kinexa LCMS XSL:FO PDF templates for Yum! Brands, Yum! Brands International, and McDonalds. 
• Designed and developed InfoPath based trainer dashboards for a LINE based project for the UK’s Royal Navy.

projects.title: Astute Training Management Information System (TMIS)
projects.description:
[Sheffield, UK & Faslane, Scotland]

TMIS is considered essential to driving consistency and efficiency into the Astute Class Submarine Training Facility.

Provided architecture design, data consulting, project management, and stakeholder support.

projects.title: UK Royal School of Military Engineers (RSME)
projects.description:
[Portsmouth, UK]

Provided on-site expertise in support of the Royal Navy and British Army revamp of civil engineering training.
